scope: Main broker/adapter/auth lifecycle S4-W1-W4,W6,W7 only; production main/view/preload wiring and fork/UI/live campaign remain required separately.

criteria.text: stale sender copies do not substitute for fresh post-dialog authority
criteria.test_id: S4-W2a stale sender copies do not substitute for fresh post-dialog authority

criteria.test_id: S4-W2b navigation or auth change during native confirmation leaves consent unchanged

criteria.test_id: S4-W4 provider statuses distinguish consent from observed child application without secrets

criteria.test_id: S4-W7c disposal failure blocks new starts rather than claiming revocation

criteria.test_id: S4-W7d identity change blocks in-flight starts until owned disposal settles
